page_title: VAL 3-1 BAR | Valencia v Barcelona 23/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+10' Gavi (Barcelona) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.

90+7' 3 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Wojciech Szczesny. 3:1.
90+7' It is time for a substitution. Andre Almeida (Valencia) is on for Javi Guerra.
90+6' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90+5' The resulting corner from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

90+5' Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a fantastic save! Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top right corner, but the effort is kept out. Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
90+4' The resulting corner from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) comes to nothing.
90+4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona). Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+3' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes a short corner kick.
90+1' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) works the corner short.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Javi Guerra (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Valencia earn a corner.
89' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 6:5. The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 10:8.

85' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the right-hand post. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Stole Dimitrievski with a fabulous save.
85' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
83' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Ferran Torres and he is replaced by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona).
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Marc Casado (Barcelona) is replacing Marc Bernal.
81' A cooling break is underway.
81' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.
80' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Jesus Vazquez will be replaced by Thierry Rendall (Valencia).
80' Here's the change. Hugo Duro leaves the pitch and Umar Sadiq (Valencia) comes on as a substitute.
79' Marc Bernal (Barcelona) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
79' The Valencia players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Adrian Cordero. NO PENALTY! Valencia are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
77' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Valencia, he's going to review using VAR.
76' Marc Bernal (Barcelona) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Valencia.
74' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
72' Total attempts – 17:9. 5:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
71' 2 - 1 The attempt by Javi Guerra is blocked, but from the middle of the box Luis Rioja (Valencia) hits the rebound into the bottom right corner. He alters the score to 2:1.
70' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Adrian Cordero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Xavi Espart (Barcelona) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.

66' 1 - 1 Goal! The ball breaks to Javi Guerra (Valencia) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 1:1.
65' Unai Nunez (Valencia) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
65' Referee Adrian Cordero signals NO PENALTY for Valencia after a VAR review!

64' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Valencia.
63' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
62' PENALTY APPEAL after Unai Nunez (Valencia) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
62' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Dani Olmo is replaced by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eric Garcia trots off the pitch and is replaced by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona).
61' 0 - 1 Goal! Ferran Torres takes aim and his effort deflects off Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) to beat the goalkeeper. 0:1.
60' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
59' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) sends a long cross over to Robert Lewandowski, but Stole Dimitrievski comes forward to gather the ball.
57' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
55' Unai Nunez (Valencia) attacks the corner from Luis Rioja in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar.
55' The referee awards a corner and Luis Rioja (Valencia) goes over to take it.
54' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Valencia will take a corner.
52' Carlos Corberan is forced to make a change. Diego Lopez is unable to continue due to injury, Largie Ramazani (Valencia) comes on.
52' It doesn’t look good for Diego Lopez (Valencia); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
51' Diego Lopez (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' The ball is cleared after Javi Guerra (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
49' The attendance is 46457.
47' Luis Rioja (Valencia) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
46' Hansi Flick makes a switch. Xavi Espart is coming on in place of Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Luis Rioja (Valencia) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45+5' Unai Nunez (Valencia) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the roof of the net, but Wojciech Szczesny is alert and denies him.
45+5' Luis Rioja (Valencia) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

45+4' Jesus Vazquez almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Diego Lopez (Valencia) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valencia.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Pepelu (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' CHANCE! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the left post!
45' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

45' A cross is whipped into the box by Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) and Dani Olmo controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
43' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle and it's Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
42' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
40' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

39' Luis Rioja nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Javi Guerra (Valencia), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance. The referee blows his whistle, Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
39' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
38' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
38' Javi Guerra (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee signals a corner kick to Valencia.
38' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
36' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' 7:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
31' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
29' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but Wojciech Szczesny makes a decent save to stop the effort.
29' Luis Rioja (Valencia) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
28' Diego Lopez (Valencia) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
27' Barcelona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
25' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
24' Luis Rioja (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
24' Stole Dimitrievski comes off his line to intercept the corner from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona).
23' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
21' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
19' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. Barcelona win a corner.
18' Great ball in from Diego Lopez. Hugo Duro (Valencia) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 28:72.
16' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is penalised for a foul. Adrian Cordero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
13' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stole Dimitrievski intercepts the ball.

11' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. Unai Nunez (Valencia) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.
10' The Barcelona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) attempts to find Robert Lewandowski with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
6' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
5' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
4' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

4' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Marcus Rashford collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a short pass into the box, Marcus Rashford takes a touch to control the ball, but one of the defenders robs him of it and clears to safety.
1' The first half has started.
Barcelona will kick the game off.
